requirements: R1: The backend DocumentSearchController must return a list of auto-complete suggestions and typo corrections for a given search query fragment.

slices.title: Patch DocumentSearchController to return autocomplete suggestions
slices.jtbd: When implementing the autocomplete API for this epic, I want to patch DocumentSearchController to return suggestions, so that the client can use real server-side typo corrections.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search query fragment
When the frontend requests suggestions
Then the backend DocumentSearchController should return auto-complete suggestions
Given unit tests, When executed, Then they should assert the returned suggestions are correct
slices.tocConstraintRef: Client-side mock limitation in search suggestions
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce client-side search typo errors by 100% via server-side resolution

requirements: R1: The DocumentSearchController must log the SEARCH event with the query via AnalyticsService when a search is performed.
R2: The frontend KnowledgeBase.svelte component must implement pagination for search results, allowing the user to view results across multiple pages.

slices.title: Patch DocumentSearchController to log search events
slices.jtbd: When implementing search event logging for this epic, I want to call AnalyticsService in DocumentSearchController, so that search queries are recorded for statistics.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user searching for documents
When the search is performed
Then DocumentSearchController should log the SEARCH event via AnalyticsService
Given a test context, When verified, Then it should assert the logging interaction occurred
slices.tocConstraintRef: Lack of visibility into user search behavior
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of search queries logged in AnalyticsService from 0% to 100%

slices.title: Patch KnowledgeBase.svelte to support pagination
slices.jtbd: When implementing frontend pagination for this epic, I want to patch KnowledgeBase.svelte, so that users can browse through a large number of search results without performance issues.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search result spanning multiple pages
When the user interacts with pagination controls
Then KnowledgeBase.svelte should render the requested page of results
Given automated tests, When run, Then they should verify the pagination state changes
slices.tocConstraintRef: Frontend rendering bottleneck for large search results
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce frontend rendering latency for large search queries by displaying only paginated results

requirements: R1: The FileDownloadController must verify that the user's role has permission to access the specific requested document before serving the file.

slices.title: Patch FileDownloadController to enforce document access authorization
slices.jtbd: When implementing document access authorization for this epic, I want to patch FileDownloadController to verify specific document permissions, so that unauthorized users cannot download sensitive documents.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user requesting a file
When their role lacks access to the specific document
Then FileDownloadController should reject the download
Given unit tests, When run, Then they should assert the authorization checks fail correctly
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized document download incidents to 0
